scene: You step off the night bus into a smoky-blue subterranean jazz club.
picture: On a level floor, the rear bumper of a glowing night bus sits at the far left door. The brass band plays on a stage on the left. The player stands centre-left facing forward, near an empty candlelit table in the centre. A curved drink counter stands on the right.
shown: a lively four-piece brass band performing on a low stage on the left
an unoccupied round wooden table with a lit candle in the centre
a cheerful bartender polishing a tall glass behind a counter on the right

variants.scene: Brass horns ring out as you step from the bus into the underground club.
